capture.setup: docker run --name fxlab-d-pg1 --hostname pg-primary -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust postgres:17 -c wal_level=replica -c max_wal_senders=5 -c cluster_name=fxlab-pg; roles: openmap LOGIN with pg_monitor (the read-only discovery account), replicator REPLICATION; databases inventory (5000 rows) and billing (20000 rows); replica fxlab-d-pg2 (hostname pg-replica) built with pg_basebackup -R -X stream and started with cluster_name=fxlab-pg-replica, streaming from fxlab-d-pg1.
capture.command: Recording TCP proxy (lab-only Go program inside apps/collectors, removed after capture) between the OpenMap database collector's real prober (Collector.Collect from the Windows host, engine option set, port = proxy) and the container's 127.0.0.1-published port; every byte each side sent is stored in order, one file per TCP connection, with wire.json indexing the direction, offset and length of each contiguous segment. Target 127.0.0.1:55433 (pg-replica), user openmap, trust authentication.

files.name: wire.json
files.description: Index of the recorded conversation: per connection, ordered client/server segments (offset, length) into the .bin file

files.name: wire/conn-1.bin
files.description: Raw TCP bytes of connection 1 exactly as exchanged (client and server segments concatenated in order)
